subject: Add QTL x covariate interaction to a multiple-QTL model

messages.author: ca77848d1fce7fe3
messages.subject: Add QTL x covariate interaction to a multiple-QTL model
parts:
Dear Dr.Karl broman , 
I want to run multiple qtl with covariate  (my control data as covariate for treatment data) and also its interaction. For scanone I used below script  and it was ok 
out_HK_2<-scanone(QTL_root_length_TREATMENT_1,pheno.col=2,method= "hk", addcovar = RL_C ,intcovar= RL_C)
but for multiple qtl analysis I used this : 
qc <- c(1, 4, 6,8)
qp <- c(15.1, 77, 69,79)
QTL__root_length_TREATMENT <- subset(QTL__root_length_TREATMENT, chr=qc)
QTL__root_length_TREATMENT <- calc.genoprob(QTL__root_length_TREATMENT, step=2, err=0.001)
qtl <- makeqtl(QTL_LR4_cadmium_root_length_TREATMENT, qc, qp, what="prob")
covar <- data.frame(RL_C=QTL_root_length_TREATMENT$pheno$RL_C)
addcovarint(QTL_root_length_TREATMENT , pheno.col=2, qtl, covar,"RL_C", y~Q1+Q2+Q3+Q4, method="hk")
but I received  this error 

Error in fitqtlengine(pheno = pheno, qtl = qtl, covar = covar, formula = formula,  :

  NA/NaN/Inf in foreign function call (arg 6)

In addition: Warning message:

In fitqtlengine(pheno = pheno, qtl = qtl, covar = covar, formula = formula,  :

  NAs introduced by coercion

 I want to know if the use of this script was correct at all or am I completely wrong?

Thank you in advance

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Add QTL x covariate interaction to a multiple-QTL model
parts:
I think it may be that it's not omitting missing values as it should.
Try

   data_subset <- subset(QTL_root_length_TREATMENT, ind=!is.na(QTL_root_length_TREATMENT$pheno$RL_C))

and working with that.

karl
